The helper is entered by a TAIL JUMP from //! `__rt_throw_current`, so there is no frame to spill into either; `_exc_value` is still //! published throughout, which makes the global the cheapest place to keep it. Because this helper is //! reached by a tail jump, `rsp` arrives 16-aligned or 8-off depending on whether the throwing //! site `call`ed or `jmp`ed into `__rt_throw_current`, so the call cannot guarantee SysV's //! entry invariant.
